title: Decoupling Solving from Abstention: Single-Rollout Conformal Risk Control for Hard-Budget LLM Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2611.31065v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Hard token budgets often interrupt LLM reasoning before an answer is produced. Forcing reasoning to terminate recovers correct solutions but also increases confident errors, creating a joint challenge of solving within budget and deciding when to abstain. Existing remedies are costly or lack guarantees: supervised fine-tuning offers no error control, penalizing wrong answers during reinforcement learning (RL) can suppress exploration, and multi-sample conformal methods multiply inference cost. We propose Tail-CRC, a single-rollout framework that separates candidate generation from submission control. We first adapt the solver to budget forcing with pure binary correctness rewards; after freezing it, we apply conformal risk control to upper-tail token surprise in the answer span. Each rollout yields both an answer and an uncertainty score from token log probabilities, enabling finite-sample control of expected wrong submissions under exch

translated_title: 解耦求解与弃答：面向硬预算大语言模型推理的单次采样保形风险控制
translated_abstract: 严格的token预算常常在大语言模型产生答案之前就中断其推理过程。强制推理终止虽然能够恢复正确解答，但也会增加“自信但错误”的回答，由此形成了一个联合挑战：既要在预算内完成求解，又要决定何时弃答。现有的补救措施要么代价高昂，要么缺乏保证：监督微调无法提供错误控制；在强化学习（RL）中惩罚错误答案可能抑制探索；多样本保形方法则会成倍增加推理成本。我们提出Tail-CRC，一个将候选生成与提交控制相分离的单次采样框架。我们首先使用纯二元正确性奖励使求解器适应预算强制；在冻结求解器之后，对其答案区间的上尾token意外度施加保形风险控制。每次采样都通过token对数概率同时产生一个答案和一个不确定性分数，从而在可交换性条件下实现对期望错误提交次数的有限样本控制。
tldr: 提出Tail-CRC单次采样框架，将求解与弃答解耦——先以纯二元正确性奖励训练适应预算强制的求解器，再对其答案区间的上尾token意外度施加保形风险控制，从而在硬token预算下无需多样本推理即可实现对期望错误提交的有限样本统计保证。
en_tdlr: Tail-CRC decouples solving from abstention in a single rollout—first training a budget-adapted solver with pure binary correctness rewards, then applying conformal risk control to upper-tail token surprise in the answer span—to achieve finite-sample control of expected wrong submissions under hard token budgets without multiplying inference cost.
